import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007; // using the same modulus
    static final long INF = (long)1e18;
    static final int MX = 200005;
    static final double PI = 4 * Math.atan(1);
    static long[][] comb = new long[61][61];
    static int R, C;
    static String S;
    static List<long[]>[] dpL = new ArrayList[31];
    static List<long[]>[] dpR = new ArrayList[31];
    static long ans = 0;
    static long[][] dp = new long[31][31];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        init();
        dfsL(0, R - 1, R - 1, 0, 0);
        dfsR(0, R + C, R + C, 0, 0);
        long dif = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
            Collections.sort(dpL[i], Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            dpR[i].sort(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            Collections.reverse(dpR[i]);
            int ind = 0;
            for (long[] t : dpL[i]) {
                while (ind + 1 < dpR[i].size() && t[0] + dpR[i].get(ind + 1)[0] >= 0) ind++;
                dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t[0] + dpR[i].get(ind)[0]));
                if (ind + 1 < dpR[i].size()) {
                    dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t[0] + dpR[i].get(ind + 1)[0]));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
            List<long[]> z = new ArrayList<>();
            for (long[] t : dpR[i]) {
                if (ok(rev((int) t[1], C + 1))) {
                    z.add(t);
                }
            }
            int l = 0, r = -1;
            for (long[] t : dpL[i]) {
                while (l < z.size() && t[0] + z.get(l)[0] > dif) l++;
                while (r + 1 < z.size() && t[0] + z.get(r + 1)[0] >= -dif) r++;
                if (l <= r) {
                    check(t[1] | (rev((int) z.get(l)[1], C + 1) << (C + 1)), r - l + 1);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void init() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;
        String line = br.readLine();
        String[] parts = line.trim().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        S = br.readLine();

        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j] + comb[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 30; i++) {
            dpL[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            dpR[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void dfsL(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpL[a].add(new long[]{p, mask});
            return;
        }
        dfsL(ind + 1, a + 1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind),
                p + (comb[a + 1][R] - comb[a][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsL(ind + 1, a, b + 1, mask,
                p - (comb[b + 1][R] - comb[b][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static void dfsR(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpR[a].add(new long[]{p, mask});
            return;
        }
        dfsR(ind + 1, a - 1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind),
                p + (comb[a][R] - comb[a - 1][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsR(ind + 1, a, b - 1, mask,
                p - (comb[b][R] - comb[b - 1][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static boolean ok(int x) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= C; i++) {
            if (((x & (1 << i)) != 0) && S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'B') return false;
            if (((x & (1 << i)) == 0) && S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'A') return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void check(long x, int t) {
        ans += t;
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        long mask = x;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * C + 1; i++) {
            if (((mask & (1L << i)) != 0)) a++;
            else b++;
            if (a > 0 && b > 0) {
                for (int j = i; j < 2 * C + 2; j++) {
                    boolean bitSet = ((mask & (1L << j)) != 0);
                    if (bitSet && S.charAt(S.length() - (2 * C + 2) + j) == 'B') return;
                    if (!bitSet && S.charAt(S.length() - (2 * C + 2) + j) == 'A') return;
                }
                int aa = 0, bb = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < S.length() - (2 * C + 2) + i; j++) {
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'A') aa++;
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'B') bb++;
                }
                long tmp;
                if (((mask & (1L << i)) != 0)) {
                    tmp = comb[R - 1 - aa + b + R - 1 - bb][R - 1 - aa];
                } else {
                    tmp = comb[a + R - 1 - aa + R - 1 - bb][a + R - 1 - aa];
                }
                ans += t * tmp;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    static long rev(int x, int y) {
        long z = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            if (((x & (1 << i)) != 0)) {
                z ^= (1L << (y - 1 - i));
            }
        }
        return z;
    }
}
